<thought>We need to find the template that, when applied retrosynthetically to the target molecule, gives the precursors ["O=Cc1ccc(F)cc1", "Clc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1"]. The forward reaction is a substitution of an aliphatic hydroxyl (C‑O bond) by a halogen (C‑X bond). The appropriate functional groups are “aliphatic hydroxyls” (broken) and “alkyl halide” (formed). I will search the template catalog with these criteria using the target SMILES inferred from the precursors combined (a plausible product). Then I will retrieve the template ID and its mapped reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=Cc1ccc(F)cc1Clc1ccc(CN2CC(F)C2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
